g.text: Panel (a): points are per-seed values; markers show the mean with a 95% bootstrap CI; the main test is a two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test on the per-seed real − resettable differences. Panel (b): points per seed, line through means. Panel (c): cell = mean(real) − mean(resettable) effect size; real exceeds resettable in every cell.
